name: Chinese Article Comparison
description: Compare Chinese-language/script articles against non-Chinese articles on the compare projects page with performant server-side aggregate stats.

userStories.title: Materialize Chinese article category
userStories.description: As a developer, I want each comparison-serving article categorized by language/script so later stats can split Chinese and non-Chinese articles without per-request text scans.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a derived category for `chinese` and `non_chinese` based on language metadata or CJK Han characters in title/abstract.
Add the category column to `mart.comparison_article_serving` through the DuckDB migration flow.
Populate the category in `comparisonProjectServingRollupBuilder.ts` during serving rebuilds.
Mark comparison serving generations stale so categories are regenerated after migration.
Add serving rollup tests for metadata language, CJK title/abstract, and non-Chinese cases.
`bun run db:mig` passes.
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingRollupBuilder.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Aggregate stats by article category
userStories.description: As a developer, I want comparison stats aggregated by Chinese and non-Chinese category so sensitivity, specificity, and related metrics use independent denominators.
acceptanceCriteria: Join `mart.comparison_cell_serving` to `mart.comparison_article_serving` by comparison project, generation, and article ID in stats aggregate SQL.
Aggregate existing comparison stats by `comparison_id` and article category without returning article-level rows.
Aggregate resolved-truth confusion counts by category for Human and LLM metrics.
Return category article counts so the UI can hide the section when Chinese article count is 0.
Keep the existing all-articles stats unchanged.
Add stats tests for independent category denominators and null metric handling.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectStats.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Expose category breakdowns in stats API types
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I want typed category breakdowns from the stats endpoint so the compare projects page can render the new split safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend `/api/comparison-projects/:id/stats` to return `categoryBreakdowns` beside existing `comparisons` and `additionalProjectStats`.
Use a flat category breakdown shape containing category, label, article count, comparisons, and additional project stats.
Update client service types in `comparisonProjectsService.ts` without changing existing callers of all-articles stats.
Ensure category labels are stable as `Chinese` and `Non-Chinese`.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectStats.test.ts` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.

userStories.title: Render Chinese vs Non-Chinese stats
userStories.description: As a compare projects user, I want to see Chinese vs non-Chinese performance stats only when Chinese articles exist so the page stays focused and useful.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a compact Chinese vs Non-Chinese section to `comparisonProjectStatsCard.tsx`.
Hide the section when the Chinese article count is 0.
Prioritize resolved-truth metrics: resolved count, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, NPV, F1, balanced accuracy, truth prevalence, TP, FP, TN, and FN.
When no adjudicated truth exists, show agreement stats by category: overlap, conflicts, true conflicts, Cohen's kappa, sensitivity, and specificity.
Keep the current main Project Stats and Additional Project Stats tables available and unchanged.
Browser-check the compare projects page with a project containing Chinese and non-Chinese articles.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes because shared compare-project UI changed.
